name: Dukaan
shortInfo: Dukaan is a DIY e-commerce platform that lets you create your free online store, and start selling online.
brief: Dukaan enables merchants with no programming skills to set up their e-commerce store.
about:
Get access to relevant reports such as Orders, Products, Audiences, Inventory and much more through this Dukaan connector. It enables streaming of relevant Dukaan data into a user determined data warehouse automatically once you configure the relevant pipelines.

Check more about Dukaan api documentation [here](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/25389466/2s9Yynk3f7#intro).
availableData:
[Orders](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/dukaan/pipelines/orders.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the details of orders in your Dukaan Account

[Products](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/dukaan/pipelines/products.html)

[Categories](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/dukaan/pipelines/categories.html)

[Audiences](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/dukaan/pipelines/audiences.html)
